## Buster Call: Enies Lobby

Ten battleships and five Vice Admirals with orders to erase an island. Enies Lobby burned once already.

The server must win 600 battles on Enies Lobby; you must land 20. Marines defend it, everyone else is attacking.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Enies Lobby](03_paradise.md#q-17fcafa496584d06)

**Tasks**

- Server: 600 battles won on Enies Lobby (20 yours)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +720, Belly +40,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style)

## The Battle of Sabaody

Eleven Supernovas, one Admiral, a Warlord and a factory of Pacifista, all in one archipelago on the same afternoon.

The server must win 400 battles on the Sabaody Archipelago; you must land 15.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Sabaody Archipelago](04_summit_war.md#q-16f410ad3a59c0e0)

**Tasks**

- Server: 400 battles won on Sabaody (15 yours)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +600, Belly +35,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style)
